title: Use an image as a reference

body.text: Put an image link (or upload one) before your prompt so Midjourney references that image's composition/style. Great when you want a look close to a sample image — you can mix a reference image with a text description.

example: [reference image link] a product photo in the same lighting style, white background

title: Blend multiple images

body.text: You can add more than one reference image to blend ideas — e.g. image A (color tone) + image B (composition). Midjourney mixes them. Experiment with the balance to find the sweet spot.

example: [pastel-tone image] [living-room image] cozy living room in pastel tones

options.text: Using an image as a reference so the AI follows its style/composition

question: How many reference images can you add?

options.text: More than one, to blend ideas

question: When is an image prompt useful?

options.text: When you want a look/style close to a sample image
When you want to write an article

question: Can you mix a reference image with text?

options.text: Yes, use a reference image together with a text description
No, you must choose one or the other
